source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 2 (PDF 36-72), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 2 (Further Differentiation) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Prove from the definition of the derivative that \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(\cos x) = -\sin x\), \(x\) in radians. (5 marks)
(Derivative ki definition se saabit karein ke \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(\cos x) = -\sin x\) (\(x\) radians mein).)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin x\) wale saboot ki tarah: do cosines ka farq product mein badlein taa ke \(\frac{\sin(h/2)}{h/2}\) aa jaye.

book_ref.quote: Prove by definition \(\frac{d}{dx}(\cos x) = -\sin x\).

blocks.prompt:
2 Prove that \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(\csc^{-1} x) = -\dfrac{1}{|x|\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}}\) for \(x \in (-\infty, -1) \cup (1, \infty)\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(x \in (-\infty, -1) \cup (1, \infty)\) ke liye \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(\csc^{-1} x) = -\dfrac{1}{|x|\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}}\).)
blocks.explanation: \(\csc y = x\) likh kar implicit differentiation karein; principal range se \(\cot y\) ka sign tay karein.

book_ref.quote: so the Challenge most likely means: Prove formulae (2), (3) and (6).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan sab se ahem cheez sign hai. \(y\) pehle ya chauthe quadrant mein hai; chauthe quadrant mein \(\cot y\) manfi (negative) hai, aur wahan \(x\) bhi manfi hai, is liye \(x\cot y\) hamesha musbat (positive) rehta hai. Isi wajah se jawab mein \(|x|\) aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
3 Using the definition of the derivative and \(\lim_{h \to 0}\dfrac{a^{h} - 1}{h} = \ln a\), prove that \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(a^{x}) = a^{x}\ln a\) (\(a > 0\), \(a \ne 1\)). Deduce \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(e^{x})\). (5 marks)
(Derivative ki definition aur \(\lim_{h \to 0}\dfrac{a^{h} - 1}{h} = \ln a\) se saabit karein ke \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(a^{x}) = a^{x}\ln a\). Phir \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(e^{x})\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a^{x}\) ko common nikalein; yeh \(h\) par munhasir nahin.

book_ref.quote: Now, we shall find the derivative of

blocks.prompt:
4 Prove from the definition that \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(\log_a x) = \dfrac{1}{x\ln a}\), \(x > 0\). Deduce \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(\ln x)\). (5 marks)
(Definition se saabit karein ke \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(\log_a x) = \dfrac{1}{x\ln a}\), \(x > 0\). Phir \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(\ln x)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Logs ko jod kar power \(\frac{x}{h}\) banayein aur \(\lim_{h \to 0}\left(1 + \frac{h}{x}\right)^{x/h} = e\) istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: Now, we will find the derivative of

blocks.prompt:
5 Find the equations of the tangent and the normal to the curve \(x^{2} + 3xy + y^{2} = 5\) at the point \((1, 1)\). (5 marks)
(Curve \(x^{2} + 3xy + y^{2} = 5\) ke point \((1, 1)\) par tangent aur normal ki equations nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Slope implicit differentiation se; phir dono lines point-slope form se.

book_ref.quote: Once we know a point and a slope, the point-slope form of a line (Class XI) gives the line's equation.

blocks.prompt:
6 Find the equations of the tangent and the normal to the curve \(y = x^{3} - 3x + 2\) at the point where \(x = 2\). (5 marks)
(Curve \(y = x^{3} - 3x + 2\) ke \(x = 2\) wale point par tangent aur normal ki equations nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Point curve se, slope derivative se, phir point-slope form.

book_ref.quote: If \(m = f'(x_0)\) is non-zero, then the equation of the normal line is

steps: \(x + 9y - 38 = 0\); point is par poora utarta hai

blocks.prompt:
7 Find the points on the curve \(y = x^{3} - 3x^{2} - 9x + 5\) at which the tangent is parallel to the \(x\)-axis. Write the equations of the tangents and normals at these points. (5 marks)
(Curve \(y = x^{3} - 3x^{2} - 9x + 5\) ke woh points nikalein jahan tangent \(x\)-axis ke parallel ho. Wahan tangents aur normals ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x\)-axis ke parallel = slope 0. Tangent \(y = y_0\), normal \(x = x_0\).

book_ref.quote: If \(m = 0\): horizontal line \(y = y_0\)

blocks.prompt:
8 If \(x = a(t - \sin t)\) and \(y = a(1 - \cos t)\), \(a \ne 0\), find \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) and \(\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(x = a(t - \sin t)\) aur \(y = a(1 - \cos t)\) hon to \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) aur \(\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} = \frac{d}{dt}\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)\cdot\frac{dt}{dx}\); do second derivatives ki nisbat nahin.

book_ref.quote: Either write \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) in terms of \(x\) and \(y\) and differentiate it with respect to \(x\)

blocks.explanation: Pehle square root hatayein: \(\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}\,y_{1} = 1\), phir dobara differentiate karein.

book_ref.quote: Nothing new is needed to find it: just differentiate the derivative, using all the rules you already know.

blocks.prompt:
10 If \(y = \tan x\), show that \(y_{1} = 1 + y^{2}\) and \(y_{2} = 2y(1 + y^{2})\). Hence find \(y_{3}\) at \(x = 0\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(y = \tan x\) ho to dikhayein ke \(y_{1} = 1 + y^{2}\) aur \(y_{2} = 2y(1 + y^{2})\). Phir \(x = 0\) par \(y_{3}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har derivative ko \(y\) mein likhein; agla derivative chain rule se.

book_ref.quote: These successive derivatives are called higher-order derivatives.

blocks.prompt:
11 Find the intervals on which \(f(x) = 3x^{4} - 4x^{3} - 12x^{2} + 5\) is increasing or decreasing. (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = 3x^{4} - 4x^{3} - 12x^{2} + 5\) kin intervals par increasing ya decreasing hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar qadam: derivative, critical points, sub-intervals, har aik mein test point.

book_ref.quote: Step 3: If critical points exist, divide the domain into sub-intervals using the critical points.

blocks.final_answer: \((-1, 0)\) aur \((2, \infty)\) par increasing; \((-\infty, -1)\) aur \((0, 2)\) par decreasing.

blocks.prompt:
12 Find the global maximum and global minimum values of \(f(x) = x^{3} - 6x^{2} + 9x + 2\) on \([0, 4]\), and the points where they occur. (5 marks)
(\([0, 4]\) par \(f(x) = x^{3} - 6x^{2} + 9x + 2\) ki global maximum aur minimum qeematein aur un ke points nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Ummeedwar: \([0, 4]\) ke andar critical points aur dono end points; qeematein compare karein.

book_ref.quote: Find values of the function at critical points and at end points of the interval.

steps: Sab se bari \(6\) (\(x = 1, 4\)); sab se chhoti \(2\) (\(x = 0, 3\))
blocks.final_answer: Global maximum \(6\) (\(x = 1\) aur \(x = 4\) par); global minimum \(2\) (\(x = 0\) aur \(x = 3\) par).

blocks.prompt:
13 Find the global extreme values of \(f(x) = x - 2\sin x\) on \([0, \pi]\). (5 marks)
(\([0, \pi]\) par \(f(x) = x - 2\sin x\) ki global extreme qeematein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Band interval par continuous function: critical point aur end points ki qeematein compare karein.

book_ref.quote: The largest of these values is the global maximum value, and the smallest is the global minimum value.

steps: Sab se bari \(\pi\), sab se chhoti \(\dfrac{\pi}{3} - \sqrt{3}\)
blocks.final_answer: Global maximum \(\pi\) (\(x = \pi\) par); global minimum \(\dfrac{\pi}{3} - \sqrt{3}\) (\(x = \dfrac{\pi}{3}\) par).

blocks.prompt:
14 Use the Second Derivative Test to find the relative extreme values of \(f(x) = x^{4} - 4x^{3} + 4x^{2} + 1\). (5 marks)
(Second Derivative Test se \(f(x) = x^{4} - 4x^{3} + 4x^{2} + 1\) ki relative extreme qeematein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f'(x) = 0\) se stationary points; \(f''\) ka sign faisla karta hai; qeematein asal \(f\) se.

book_ref.quote: Let \(f\) be a twice differentiable function at \(x = c\), where \(c\) lies in the domain of \(f\).

blocks.final_answer: \(x = 0\) aur \(x = 2\) par relative minimum \(1\); \(x = 1\) par relative maximum \(2\).

blocks.prompt:
15 Show that \(f(x) = xe^{-x}\) has a relative maximum at \(x = 1\), and find the maximum value. (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(f(x) = xe^{-x}\) ka \(x = 1\) par relative maximum hai, aur maximum qeemat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Do dafa product rule; \(e^{-x} > 0\) kabhi zero nahin, is liye sirf polynomial factor faisla karta hai.

book_ref.quote: \(f\) has relative maximum at \(c\) if \(f''(c) < 0\).

blocks.prompt:
16 Find the local linear approximation of \(f(x) = \sqrt[3]{x}\) at \(x = 27\). Use it to approximate \(\sqrt[3]{26.5}\) and compare with the calculator value \(2.98137\). (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = \sqrt[3]{x}\) ki \(x = 27\) par local linear approximation nikalein. Is se \(\sqrt[3]{26.5}\) ka andaaza lagayein aur calculator ki qeemat \(2.98137\) se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Center perfect cube 27 par: \(L(x) = f(27) + f'(27)(x - 27)\).

book_ref.quote: is the linearization of \(f(x)\) at \(x = a\). The approximation

blocks.prompt:
17 Find the linearization of \(f(x) = \sin x\) at \(x = \dfrac{\pi}{6}\), and use it to approximate \(\sin 32^\circ\). (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = \sin x\) ki \(x = \dfrac{\pi}{6}\) par linearization nikalein aur \(\sin 32^\circ\) ka andaaza lagayein.)
blocks.explanation: Center \(30^\circ = \frac{\pi}{6}\); \(2^\circ\) ko radians mein badlein.

book_ref.quote: The point \(x = a\) is referred to as the center of the approximation.

blocks.prompt:
18 Use differentials to approximate (i) \(\sqrt{37}\) (ii) \(\tan 44^\circ\) (take \(\frac{\pi}{180} \approx 0.017453\)). (5 marks)
(Differentials se taqreebi qeematein nikalein: (i) \(\sqrt{37}\) (ii) \(\tan 44^\circ\) (\(\frac{\pi}{180} \approx 0.017453\)).)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + f'(x)\,dx\); qareebi asaan qeemat se shuru; angles mein \(dx\) radians mein.

book_ref.quote: Using Differentials to Approximate:

blocks.prompt:
19 For \(f(x) = x^{3} - 2x\), \(x = 2\) and \(dx = 0.05\), find \(dy\), \(\Delta y\), the error, the relative error and the percentage error. (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = x^{3} - 2x\), \(x = 2\), \(dx = 0.05\) ke liye \(dy\), \(\Delta y\), error, relative error aur percentage error nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(dy\) tangent line ki tabdeeli; \(\Delta y\) asal tabdeeli.

book_ref.quote: Suppose \(f\) is a differentiable function at a point \(x\), and there is a small change \(\Delta x\) in \(x\).

blocks.final_answer: \(dy = 0.5\), \(\Delta y = 0.515125\), error \(0.015125\), relative error \(\approx 0.0294\), percentage error \(\approx 2.94\%\).

blocks.prompt:
20 The radius of a sphere is measured as 12 cm with a possible error of 0.06 cm. Use differentials to estimate the errors and the percentage errors in (i) its volume (ii) its surface area. (5 marks)
(Sphere ka radius 12 cm napa gaya, mumkina error 0.06 cm. Differentials se (i) volume (ii) surface area mein error aur percentage error ka andaaza lagayein.)
blocks.explanation: \(dV = V'(r)\,dr\), \(dS = S'(r)\,dr\); percentage error \(= \left|\frac{dQ}{Q}\right| \times 100\).

book_ref.quote: Percentage error in a calculated quantity

blocks.prompt:
21 An open box is made from a square sheet of side 18 cm by cutting equal squares from the four corners and folding up the sides. Find the side of the squares that makes the volume maximum, and the maximum volume. (5 marks)
(18 cm side wali square sheet ke chaaron konon se barabar squares kaat kar aur kinare mod kar khula dabba banaya jata hai. Kate gaye square ki side kitni ho ke volume maximum ho? Maximum volume bhi nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Volume = base ka area zarb height, aik variable \(x\) mein, \(0 < x < 9\).

book_ref.quote: Formulate the Function: write an equation representing the quantity to optimize.

blocks.final_answer: 3 cm ke squares kaatein; dabba 12 \(\times\) 12 \(\times\) 3 cm, maximum volume 432 cm\(^{3}\).

blocks.prompt:
22 A closed cylindrical tin is to have a total surface area of \(24\pi\) cm\(^{2}\). Find its radius and height for which the volume is maximum, and the maximum volume. (5 marks)
(Aik band cylindrical dabbe ka kul surface area \(24\pi\) cm\(^{2}\) hai. Kis radius aur height par volume maximum hoga? Maximum volume bhi nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Muqarrar surface area se \(h\) hatayein; phir sirf \(r\) mein \(V\) ka maximum.

book_ref.quote: Find Constraints: if applicable, express limitations.

blocks.final_answer: Radius 2 cm, height 4 cm; maximum volume \(16\pi\) cm\(^{3}\).

blocks.prompt:
23 Find the points on the parabola \(y^{2} = 4x\) nearest to the point \((5, 0)\), and the least distance. (5 marks)
(Parabola \(y^{2} = 4x\) ke woh points nikalein jo point \((5, 0)\) ke sab se qareeb hon, aur kam se kam faasla.)
blocks.explanation: \(D\) ki jagah \(D^{2}\) minimum karein; \(y^{2} = 4x\) rakh kar aik variable.

book_ref.quote: A distance has a square root: minimize

blocks.final_answer: Qareeb tareen points \((3, \pm 2\sqrt{3})\); kam se kam faasla 4 units.

blocks.prompt:
24 A workshop models its weekly profit (in thousands of rupees) by \(P(x) = -2x^{3} + 15x^{2} + 36x\), where \(x\) is the number of items made (in hundreds), \(x \ge 0\). Find the output that gives the maximum profit and the maximum profit. (5 marks)
(Aik workshop apna haftawar munafa (hazaar rupay) \(P(x) = -2x^{3} + 15x^{2} + 36x\) se model karti hai, jahan \(x\) banayi gayi cheezon ki tadaad (saikron mein), \(x \ge 0\). Kis tadaad par munafa maximum hoga, aur maximum munafa kitna?)
blocks.explanation: Function pehle se aik variable mein: critical points, phir second derivative test, phir matlab bayan karein.

book_ref.quote: Verify Extrema: use the second derivative test to confirm maxima/minima.

blocks.final_answer: 600 cheezein (\(x = 6\)) banane par maximum munafa 324 hazaar rupay.
